The public cli-console-business/v1 Adapter covers all 65 exact CLI and Console project/build lanes. Callers provide exact project and file artifacts plus stable platform, language, build, migration, verification, output, source-control, and verbosity intent through one closed declaration. The Gateway derives every versioned native option, negative flag, platform pair layout, ordering, I/O root, transient Wine wire path, shell serialization, immutable Preview, non-retry boundary, project transition, and verifier. Normal typed-call, typed containers, prompt-level native CLI assembly, and custom-command hooks are blocked. #89 retains five-version deterministic and non-bypass coverage, dual-host Wwise 2022.1/2025.1 project/build evidence, and final Terra Fresh Agent WwiseConsole build-intent PASS plus identical verify-only on both hosts.

The public compound-undo-business/v1 Adapter accepts one display name plus an ordered user-requested business sequence of closed child outcomes. Its parent-owned start_child continuation creates each child with an internal parent handoff; a checked child cannot produce an independent Preview and returns only its opaque child argument plus the next-child or parent-finish choices. The Gateway snapshots each exact checked child request and schema, rejects overlapping final outcomes, derives child bindings, revisions, the fixed native begin/child/end phase dependency order with cancel-on-failure, one aggregate business-outcome verification, and one immutable parent Preview. The generic typed children remain prohibited; public Undo child schemas, call handles, native request fragments, dependency edges, and Composer ordering grammar remain unavailable, and no shallow fallback exists.

ownership_classes.bounded_domain_expression: An exact domain expression is accepted only by its reviewed read-only or code boundary.
ownership_classes.exact_user_artifact: User-owned bytes, files, paths, tables, or source text remain exact inputs inside a Gateway envelope.
ownership_classes.gateway_derivation: The Gateway deterministically derives or serializes this value or workflow mechanic.
ownership_classes.live_bound_handle: The Gateway issues a capability- and live-state-bound handle which the caller may only copy.
ownership_classes.prohibited_boundary: The value or route is intentionally unavailable through the public surface.
ownership_classes.reviewed_adapter: An operation-specific Adapter must replace the current native-facing value or structure.
ownership_classes.stable_business_declaration: A prompt-derived business value remains visible in the public request.

allowed_final_dispositions: Gateway-owned zero-input or fixed read contract with no leaked model-authored implementation value
non_exemptions: the API previously passed deterministic, real-host, or Fresh Agent tests
the API already has a dedicated route, builder, or verifier
the current typed request is already syntactically closed
uniform_migration_invariant.required_boundary: Agent supplies only closed business values or exact user artifacts; Gateway constructs the exact versioned native request and execution plan
uniform_migration_invariant.scope: every permitted public API and every supported version lane
